proposed_mapping.database: ALTER TABLE Goals MODIFY category_id INT NULL

relationship.foreign_key_behavior: Preserve the existing foreign key and relation; no cascade change.

contract.reason: UC-14 UML defines Goal.categoryId as optional [0..1], and API-GOAL-CREATE defines category_id as optional and nullable so Saving goals can be created without a category.

migration.approach: Add one TypeORM migration that changes only Goals.category_id from NOT NULL to NULL while preserving its type and existing foreign key.
migration.data_impact: No existing values are rewritten or deleted; the change only permits future NULL values.
migration.rollback: Before restoring NOT NULL, verify no Goals rows contain category_id IS NULL. Rollback must stop if such rows exist unless the researcher separately approves a data remediation plan.

out_of_scope: No index, uniqueness, cascade, or foreign-key target change
No changes for goal tracking, contributions, or milestones

assumptions: The deployed Goals.category_id column currently follows the non-nullable TypeORM entity mapping; runtime schema will be verified through Docker after approval and implementation.
Existing non-null category references remain valid after the nullability change.

approval.scope: Approve the proposed Goals.category_id nullability change for UC-14.
approval.evidence: The researcher re-invoked $gen-source-code after receiving the schema proposal and explicit approval request.

repair_proposal.trigger: Docker runtime observation after authorized sub-prompt repairs
indexes: INDEX on user_id and end_date for active-goal quota checks
INDEX on user_id, goal_type, category_id, start_date, and end_date for Saving-conflict and Expense-Limit overlap checks
repair_proposal.migration_approach: Add an earlier idempotent TypeORM migration that creates Goals only when absent; retain the already-approved nullable-category migration for environments where Goals already exists.
repair_proposal.data_impact: No existing rows are rewritten or deleted. Existing environments that already contain Goals are left unchanged by the create-if-absent step.
repair_proposal.rollback: Drop Goals only when the migration itself created an empty table. Refuse rollback when rows exist; no automatic data deletion.

runtime_schema_resolution.evidence: Read-only information_schema inspection confirmed users.id and categories.category_id are unsigned primary keys; the existing User entity maps userId to database column id.
runtime_schema_resolution.decision: Resolve the approved relationships against the actual primary-key column names and signedness without changing ownership or category semantics.
